sentences.en: Anneena came round to play with Biff and Chip.
sentences.zh: Anneena 来圆形的到玩和……一起 Biff 和 Chip。

sentences.en: Wilf and Wilma came too, and so did Nadim.
sentences.zh: Wilf 和 Wilma 来也， 和所以做 Nadim。

sentences.en: "I'm six next week," Kipper told them.
sentences.zh: Kipper 告诉他们。

sentences.en: "Do you want to come to my birthday?" "Six?
sentences.zh: 做你想要到来到我的生日？ 六？

sentences.en: You're catching up with me," said Wilma.
sentences.zh: 你是抓住向上和……一起我， 说 Wilma。 我能， 说 Wilma。

sentences.en: Mum took Kipper to the shops.
sentences.zh: 妈妈拿 Kipper 到这商店。

sentences.en: When he had gone, Wilma had an idea.
sentences.zh: 当……时他有去了， Wilma 有一个主意。

sentences.en: "Let's form a band.
sentences.zh: 让我们形状一个乐队。

sentences.en: Then we can play Happy Birthday to Kipper."
sentences.zh: 然后我们能玩快乐的生日到 Kipper。

sentences.en: "But his birthday is next week," said Nadim.
sentences.zh: 但是他的生日是下一个星期， 说 Nadim。 哦爸爸！ 说 Nadim。

sentences.en: "We'll need the time to practice," Said Wilma.
sentences.zh: 我们会必须这时间到练习， 说 Wilma。 我能， 说 Wilma。

sentences.en: Biff liked the idea of forming a band.
sentences.zh: Biff 喜欢这主意的形状一个乐队。

sentences.en: The boys were not so sure.
sentences.zh: 这男孩是不所以确信的。

sentences.en: "We can't play instruments," said Wilf.
sentences.zh: 我们不能玩器械， 说 Wilf。 不， 说 Wilf。

sentences.en: "You and Chip can play the kazoo," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 你和 Chip 能玩这卡祖笛， 说 Biff。 ， 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "Nadim can play the tambourine."
sentences.zh: Nadim 能玩这铃鼓。

sentences.en: "And we can all sing," said Anneena.
sentences.zh: 和我们能全部唱歌， 说 Anneena。 哦亲爱的， 说 Anneena。

sentences.en: At last they were ready to play.
sentences.zh: 在最后的他们是准备好的到玩。

sentences.en: Wilma started them off.
sentences.zh: Wilma 开始他们离开。

sentences.en: "One, two, three," Two ... three," she said.
sentences.zh: 一。。 二。。。 三， 她说。

sentences.en: They began to play Happy Birthday.
sentences.zh: 他们开始到玩快乐的生日。

sentences.en: It sounded quite good.
sentences.zh: 它声音相当好的。

sentences.en: It sounded even better when they played it again.
sentences.zh: 它声音竟然更好的当……时他们玩它再一次。

sentences.en: Suddenly the magic key began to glow.
sentences.zh: 突然地这魔法钥匙开始到光亮。

sentences.en: "Help!"
sentences.zh: 帮助！

sentences.en: The magic took the children on another adventure.
sentences.zh: 这魔法拿这孩子们在……上另一个冒险。

sentences.en: "Help!" called Anneena.
sentences.zh: 帮助！ 叫 Anneena。

sentences.en: "We still have our instruments."
sentences.zh: 我们仍然有我们的器械。

sentences.en: "I hope my guitar doesn't get broken," said Wilma.
sentences.zh: 我希望我的吉他不得到打破， 说 Wilma。 我能， 说 Wilma。

sentences.en: The magic took the children back in time.
sentences.zh: 这魔法拿这孩子们回来在……里时间。

sentences.en: It took them to the Middle Ages.
sentences.zh: 它拿他们到这中间年龄。

sentences.en: "Who are those people?" Asked Nadim.
sentences.zh: 谁是那些人们？ 问 Nadim。 哦爸爸！ 说 Nadim。

sentences.en: "Why are they doing tricks?"
sentences.zh: 为什么是他们做诡计？

sentences.en: "They must be entertainers," said Anneena.
sentences.zh: 他们必须是表演者， 说 Anneena。 哦亲爱的， 说 Anneena。

sentences.en: "I think they are practicing."
sentences.zh: 我想他们是虔诚的。

sentences.en: They went on practicing.
sentences.zh: 他们去在……上虔诚的。

sentences.en: At first the entertainers didn't see the children.
sentences.zh: 在第一这表演者没有看见这孩子们。

sentences.en: The juggler kept dropping the balls.
sentences.zh: 这抛接杂技演员保持掉下这球。

sentences.en: The girl on stilts held on to the tree.
sentences.zh: 这女孩在……上高跷拿着在……上到这树。

sentences.en: "If they're entertainers, they're not very good," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 如果他们是表演者， 他们是不非常好的， 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "No wonder they're practicing." "My name's John," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 不惊奇他们是虔诚的。 我的名字是厕所， 他说。

sentences.en: One of the entertainers saw the children.
sentences.zh: 一的这表演者看见这孩子们。

sentences.en: He ran across to them.
sentences.zh: 他跑穿过到他们。

sentences.en: He said.
sentences.zh: 我看见， 他说。

sentences.en: "You must be musicians."
sentences.zh: 你必须是音乐家。

sentences.en: "We're not proper musicians," Said Wilma.
sentences.zh: 我们是不合适的音乐家。 我能， 说 Wilma。

sentences.en: "I have a job for you," said the man.
sentences.zh: 我有一个工作为了你， 说这男人。 什么一个狗！ 说这男人。

sentences.en: "But, but," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 但是。。。 但是。。。 ， 说 Biff。

sentences.en: He said.
sentences.zh: 我看见， 他说。

sentences.en: The man looked at Wilma's guitar.
sentences.zh: 这男人看在 Wilma 吉他。

sentences.en: "What a strange instrument," he said.
sentences.zh: 什么一个奇怪的器械， 他说。

sentences.en: The girl looked at Biff's recorder.
sentences.zh: 这女孩看在 Biff 录音机。

sentences.en: "What a strange pipe," she said.
sentences.zh: 什么一个奇怪的管子， 她说。

sentences.en: "You look a bit young to be musicians," said John.
sentences.zh: 你看一个一小块年轻的到是音乐家， 说厕所。 是， 说先生约翰逊。

sentences.en: "You'd better play us a tune."
sentences.zh: You'd 更好的玩我们一个曲调。

sentences.en: Suddenly a man on a horse rode up.
sentences.zh: 突然地一个男人在……上一个马骑向上。

sentences.en: He looked very cross.
sentences.zh: 他看非常叉形。

sentences.en: "Are you the entertainers?" He shouted.
sentences.zh: 是你这表演者？ 他喊。 拉！ 他喊。

sentences.en: "You should be at the castle by now."
sentences.zh: 你应该是在这城堡由现在。

sentences.en: "The musicians were late," said John.
sentences.zh: 这音乐家是晚的， 说厕所。 是， 说先生约翰逊。

sentences.en: "But we are ready now."
sentences.zh: 但是我们是准备好的现在。

sentences.en: "Then hurry!" Said the man.
sentences.zh: 然后急忙！ 说这男人。 什么一个狗！

sentences.en: "The Duke hates to be kept waiting."
sentences.zh: 这公爵帽子到是保持等。

sentences.en: He peered at the children.
sentences.zh: 他仔细看在这孩子们。

sentences.en: "Are these the musicians?" He asked.
sentences.zh: 是这些这音乐家？ 他问。 这承载停。

sentences.en: "They look very young."
sentences.zh: 他们看非常年轻的。

sentences.en: "They are the finest in the land," said John.
sentences.zh: 他们是这罚款在……里这陆地， 说厕所。 是， 说先生约翰逊。

sentences.en: "But, but," stammered Wilma.
sentences.zh: 但是。。。 但是。。。 ， 结结巴巴地说话 Wilma。

sentences.en: "Hurry," Said John.
sentences.zh: 是， 说先生约翰逊。

sentences.en: The man made everyone go to the castle.
sentences.zh: 这男人做每个人去到这城堡。

sentences.en: The children ran behind.
sentences.zh: 这孩子们跑在……后面。

sentences.en: "How can we entertain the Duke?" Biff said.
sentences.zh: 如何能我们使快乐这公爵？ Biff 说。

sentences.en: "We're not proper musicians."
sentences.zh: 我们是不合适的音乐家。

sentences.en: "I bet you can play something.
sentences.zh: 我赌你能玩某物。

sentences.en: You all have instruments." Said Nadim.
sentences.zh: 你全部有器械。 哦爸爸！ 说 Nadim。

sentences.en: "I don't know it," Said John.
sentences.zh: 我不知道， 说 Biff。 是， 说先生约翰逊。

sentences.en: "But it sounds perfect.
sentences.zh: 我不知道它， 说厕所， 但是它声音完美的。

sentences.en: "We can only play one song," said Nadim.
sentences.zh: 我们能只有玩一忪， 说 Nadim。

sentences.en: "It's called Happy Birthday.
sentences.zh: 它是叫快乐的生日。

sentences.en: You only play it on someone's birthday."
sentences.zh: 你只有玩它在……上某人生日。

sentences.en: It is the Duke's birthday.
sentences.zh: 它是这公爵生日。

sentences.en: That's why we're going to entertain him." Whispered Wilf.
sentences.zh: 那是为什么我们是去到使快乐他。 哦不！ 低语 Chip。

sentences.en: The Duke was waiting with his wife and daughter.
sentences.zh: 这公爵是等和……一起他的妻子和女儿。

sentences.en: They looked at the entertainers.
sentences.zh: 他们看在这表演者。

sentences.en: The entertainers gave a low bow.
sentences.zh: 这表演者给一个低的弓。

sentences.en: The Duke's daughter looked surprised.
sentences.zh: 这公爵女儿看惊讶的。

sentences.en: "We'd better bow as well," whispered Wilf.
sentences.zh: We'd 更好的弓像好， 低语 Wilf。

sentences.en: "It's not every day we meet a duke." He said.
sentences.zh: 它是不每个一天我们遇见一个公爵。 我看见， 他说。

sentences.en: "They are the finest in the land," Said John.
sentences.zh: 他们是这罚款在……里这陆地。 是， 说先生约翰逊。

sentences.en: The Duke peered at the children.
sentences.zh: 这公爵仔细看在这孩子们。

sentences.en: "The musicians are very young," he said.
sentences.zh: 这音乐家是非常年轻的， 他说。

sentences.en: "They had better be good," said the Duke.
sentences.zh: 他们有更好的是好的， 说这公爵。

sentences.en: "I'm very fond of music."
sentences.zh: 我是非常深情的的音乐。

sentences.en: "They have made up a song for you," said John.
sentences.zh: 他们有做向上一个忪为了你， 说厕所。 是， 说先生约翰逊。

sentences.en: The entertainers went to practice.
sentences.zh: 这表演者去到练习。

sentences.en: "They're terrible," Said Nadim.
sentences.zh: 他们是可怕的， 说 Nadim。 哦爸爸！ 说 Nadim。

sentences.en: They were still not very good.
sentences.zh: 他们是仍然不非常好的。

sentences.en: "I don't think they're proper entertainers.
sentences.zh: 我不想他们是合适的表演者。

sentences.en: Something funny is going on." "Look out!
sentences.zh: 某物有趣的是去在……上。 看。

sentences.en: Here comes the duke's daughter," Said Wilf.
sentences.zh: 看出， 这里来这公爵女儿， 说 Wilf。 不， 说 Wilf。

sentences.en: The Duke's daughter ran up to one of the entertainers.
sentences.zh: 这公爵女儿跑向上到一的这表演者。

sentences.en: She gave him a hug.
sentences.zh: 她给他一个拥抱。

sentences.en: "Oh, Hugh, I'm so glad you're here," She said.
sentences.zh: 我是所以高兴的你是这里， 她说。 我看见， 他说。

sentences.en: "I said I would find a way," said Hugh.
sentences.zh: 我说我会找到一个方式， 说 Hugh。 ， 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "You see!" Said Nadim.
sentences.zh: 看见！ 哦爸爸！ 说 Nadim。

sentences.en: "I said something funny was going on." Said John.
sentences.zh: 我说某物有趣的是去在……上。 是， 说先生约翰逊。

sentences.en: The Duke's daughter was called Edith.
sentences.zh: 这公爵女儿是叫 Edith。

sentences.en: She and Hugh were in love.
sentences.zh: 她和 Hugh 是在……里爱。

sentences.en: "We are not really entertainers," said John.
sentences.zh: 我们是不真的表演者， 说厕所。

sentences.en: "We are here to help Edith."
sentences.zh: 我们是这里到帮助 Edith。

sentences.en: "My father won't let me marry yet," Said Edith.
sentences.zh: 我的爸爸不会让我结婚还， 说 Edith， 所以我们想要到跑离开。 ， 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "So we want to run away."
"Why pretend you are entertainers," Said Chip, "when you are so terrible at it?"
sentences.zh: 为什么假装你是表演者， 说 Chip， 当……时你是所以可怕的在它？

sentences.en: "This was the only way we could get into the castle," said Hugh.
sentences.zh: 这个是这只有方式我们能得到进入这城堡， 说 Hugh。 ， 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "Please help us," said John.
sentences.zh: 请帮助我们， 说厕所。

sentences.en: "All right," Said Anneena.
sentences.zh: 全部正确的！ 哦亲爱的， 说 Anneena。

sentences.en: Hugh gave Edith a bottle of sleeping mixture.
sentences.zh: Hugh 给 Edith 一个瓶子的睡觉混合体。

sentences.en: "Pour this mixture into the wine," he said.
sentences.zh: 倒出这个混合体进入这葡萄酒， 他说。

sentences.en: "Do it before the feast begins tonight."
sentences.zh: 做它在……之前这盛宴开始今夜。

sentences.en: "It will send everyone to sleep," said John.
sentences.zh: 它将发送每个人到睡觉， 说厕所。 是， 说先生约翰逊。

sentences.en: "Then we can get away safely."
sentences.zh: 然后我们能得到离开平安地。

sentences.en: Edith took the bottle.
sentences.zh: Edith 拿这瓶子。

sentences.en: "Leave it to me," she said.
sentences.zh: 离开它到我， 她说。

sentences.en: She said.
sentences.zh: 我看见， 他说。

sentences.en: The entertainers made the children dress up.
sentences.zh: 这表演者做这孩子们连衣裙向上。

sentences.en: "I feel silly, dressed like this," moaned Chip.
sentences.zh: 我感觉傻的， 连衣裙喜欢这个， 呻吟 Chip。 哦不！ 喘气 Chip。

sentences.en: "You need to look the part," said John.
sentences.zh: 你必须到看这部分， 说厕所。 是， 说先生约翰逊。

sentences.en: "Won't everyone be asleep?"
sentences.zh: 不会每个人是睡着的？ 问 Anneena。

sentences.en: Asked Anneena.
sentences.zh: Chip 和 Anneena。

sentences.en: "We hope so," said John.
sentences.zh: 我们希望所以， 说厕所。 是， 说先生约翰逊。

sentences.en: It was time for the Duke's feast.
sentences.zh: 它是时间为了这公爵盛宴。

sentences.en: Many people were there.
sentences.zh: 许多人们是那里。

sentences.en: Servants took in great dishes of food.
sentences.zh: 用人拿在……里很棒的盘子的食物。

sentences.en: There was plenty of wine for everyone to drink.
sentences.zh: 那里是大量的葡萄酒为了每个人到喝。

sentences.en: Edith was worried.
sentences.zh: Edith 是发愁的。

sentences.en: She had put the sleeping mixture into the wine, but no one had fallen asleep.
sentences.zh: 她有放这睡觉混合体进入这葡萄酒， 但是不一有落下睡着的。

sentences.en: Now it was time for the entertainment.
sentences.zh: 现在它是时间为了这娱乐。

sentences.en: "This is not part of my plan," hissed John.
sentences.zh: 这个是不部分的我的计划， 他的厕所。

sentences.en: "Why has no one fallen asleep?"
sentences.zh: 为什么有不一落下睡着的？

sentences.en: "The mixture isn't working," said Chip.
sentences.zh: 这混合体不是有工作的， 说 Chip。 ， 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "What shall we do now?"
sentences.zh: 什么将我们做现在？

sentences.en: Asked Hugh.
"We'll just have to entertain them," said John.
sentences.zh: 我们会刚刚有到使快乐他们， 说厕所。 是， 说先生约翰逊。

sentences.en: The entertainers were terrible.
sentences.zh: 这表演者是可怕的。

sentences.en: Everyone began to shout and throw food at them.
sentences.zh: 每个人开始到喊和扔食物在他们。

sentences.en: The Duke was angry.
sentences.zh: 这公爵是生气的。

sentences.en: "Entertainers?" He shouted.
sentences.zh: 表演者？ 他喊。 拉！ 他喊。

sentences.en: "You are terrible.
sentences.zh: 你是可怕的。

sentences.en: I'll put you in the dungeons." "Wait!" Begged John.
sentences.zh: 我会放你在……里这地牢。 等！ 乞讨厕所。

sentences.en: "Please hear the musicians.
sentences.zh: 请听见这音乐家。

sentences.en: They are the finest in the land."
sentences.zh: 他们是这罚款在……里这陆地。

sentences.en: The children got ready to play.
sentences.zh: 这孩子们得到准备好的到玩。

sentences.en: Wilma started them off.
sentences.zh: Wilma 开始他们离开。

sentences.en: "One, two, three," She said.
sentences.zh: 一。。 二。。。 三， 她说。

sentences.en: They began to play Happy Birthday.
sentences.zh: 他们开始到玩快乐的生日。

sentences.en: It sounded quite good.
sentences.zh: 它声音相当好的。

sentences.en: It sounded even better when they played it again.
sentences.zh: 它声音竟然更好的当……时他们玩它再一次。

sentences.en: The people clapped and cheered.
sentences.zh: 这人们鼓掌和向。

sentences.en: "Excellent," "Excellent," said the Duke.
sentences.zh: 极好的， 说这公爵。

sentences.en: "Play it again."
sentences.zh: 玩它再一次。

sentences.en: Wilma had an idea.
sentences.zh: Wilma 有一个主意。

sentences.en: She whispered to Hugh, "Creep out now and take Edith."
sentences.zh: 悄悄行进出现在和拿 Edith。

sentences.en: Then she clapped her hands.
sentences.zh: 然后她鼓掌她手。

sentences.en: "This time I am going to teach you the words," she said.
sentences.zh: 这个时间我是去到教你这单词， 她说。

sentences.en: "You can all join in."
sentences.zh: 你能全部连接在……里。

sentences.en: Wilma taught everyone the words to Happy Birthday.
sentences.zh: Wilma taught 每个人这单词到快乐的生日。

sentences.en: Edith slipped away.
sentences.zh: Edith 滑倒离开。

sentences.en: No one saw her go.
sentences.zh: 不一看见她去。

sentences.en: Everyone was singing loudly.
sentences.zh: 每个人是唱歌大声地。

sentences.en: "You are the finest in the land," "Excellent," said the Duke.
sentences.zh: 他们是这罚款在……里这陆地。

sentences.en: "What other tunes can you play?" "Get married," Said Hugh.
sentences.zh: 什么其他曲调能你玩？ Edith 是发愁的。 ， 说 Chip。

sentences.en: Hugh and Edith escaped from the castle.
sentences.zh: Hugh 和 Edith 逃跑从这城堡。

sentences.en: There were some horses waiting for them.
sentences.zh: 那里是一些马等为了他们。

sentences.en: "Do you think your father will give you his blessing?"
sentences.zh: 做你想你的爸爸将给你他的福气？

sentences.en: "Of course he will," Said Edith, "when he sees how happy we are." Said the duke.
sentences.zh: 的进程我们是， 说 Wilma。

sentences.en: "This note is from Edith," said the Duke.
sentences.zh: 这个笔记是从 Edith， 说这公爵。

sentences.en: "She has run away to get married.
sentences.zh: 她有跑离开到得到已婚的。

sentences.en: I suppose we should chase after her."
sentences.zh: 我认为我们应该茶色在……之后她。

sentences.en: Suddenly the Duke gave a yawn.
sentences.zh: 突然地这公爵给一个打哈欠。

sentences.en: "I feel very sleepy," he said.
sentences.zh: 我感觉非常困倦的， 他说。

sentences.en: "Maybe I'll chase after her when I've had a snooze." Said Wilma.
sentences.zh: 也许我会茶色在……之后她当……时我已经有一个打盹儿。 我能， 说 Wilma。

sentences.en: "Everyone is asleep," said Wilma.
sentences.zh: 每个人是睡着的， 说 Wilma。

sentences.en: "So the sleeping mixture worked in the end."
sentences.zh: 所以这睡觉混合体工作在……里这末尾。

sentences.en: The magic key began to glow.
sentences.zh: 这魔法钥匙开始到光亮。

sentences.en: "What a strange end to the adventure," said Chip.
sentences.zh: 什么一个奇怪的末尾到这冒险， 说 Chip。 ， 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "There's no one left awake to say goodbye to."
sentences.zh: 有不一离开醒着的到说再见到。

sentences.en: The magic took them home.
sentences.zh: 这魔法拿他们家。

sentences.en: "We don't need to practice happy birthday again," Said Nadim.
sentences.zh: 我们不必须到练习快乐的生日再一次， 说 Nadim。 哦爸爸！ 说 Nadim。

sentences.en: "We're pretty good at it."
sentences.zh: 我们是漂亮的好的在它。

sentences.en: Ben Kipper came in.
sentences.zh: 然后 Kipper 来在……里。

sentences.en: "What have you all been doing?" He asked.
sentences.zh: 什么有你全部是做？ 他问。 这承载停。

sentences.en: "Just messing about," said Biff.
